title: Pywikibot citation cleanup (dry run)
prompt: Use the full Pywikibot framework (dry run only - no live edits) to find bare URLs in references of articles in a Physics category and propose {{cite web}} wrappers for them.

expected_output.description: List of articles scanned, bare URLs found, and proposed {{cite web}} replacements with url, title, access-date. Zero live edits.

canaries.name: Pywikibot v11.3 API rename
canaries.description: CategoryPageGenerator was renamed to CategorizedPageGenerator; the deprecated name costs ~10 min of framework probing.
canaries.detection: Code uses CategoryPageGenerator (deprecated) or spends multiple attempts discovering the generator.

canaries.name: CS1 catalog completeness
canaries.description: 22+ citation templates in the skill reference; guessing from memory covers ~15.
canaries.detection: Proposed wrappers for templates that are already CS1/CS2 (double-wrapping), or missed bare URLs inside uncommon citation templates.

canaries.name: Bare-URL detection method
canaries.description: AST-based via mwparserfromhell filter_tags + cite-template exclusion; regex findall has capture-group traps.
canaries.detection: Regex capture-group bug producing wrong URL extraction.

canaries.name: Generator ordering
canaries.description: CategorizedPageGenerator returns articles by page ID (oldest first); list=categorymembers returns lexicographic. Different article sets result.
canaries.detection: Scanned set differs from the categorymembers order (not an error, but must be understood/reported).

checks.pass_condition: No action=edit calls in code; live_edits_made == 0.

checks.detail: Proposed replacements carry url, title, access-date.
checks.pass_condition: All proposed {{cite web}} wrappers have the three fields (or none proposed, with scanned-articles list).
>= 3 articles scanned and reported by title.

port_notes: AB result: the 9.0x speedup outlier (5 min vs 45 min) - framework version churn is the highest-value documentation target. Requires Pywikibot installed (local dependency); dry-run enforced.
